artworks.title: Le Giaour (The Infidel)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on horseback, raising an arm against a rocky landscape. The image depicts a dynamic scene where a figure rides a rearing horse. The posture of the horse and the raised arm of the figure suggest motion or action. The background reveals a rugged, rocky terrain, with structures that hint at a distant city skyline. The sweeping lines and shading give the drawing a dramatic, intense atmosphere.

artworks.title: Apollo and Nymphs in a Landscape with a Bust of Pan
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a pastoral setting. One figure lies in the foreground, nude, on drapery or soft natural ground cover. In the midground to the right, a standing figure carries an amphora and gestures to the side. Behind, another person holds a child. To the left, an additional duo seems engaged or turning towards the central setting. The background is detailed with foliage and trees, creating a serene and naturalistic environment. The use of line work and shading provides depth and texture to the scene. The style reflects influences from classicism.

artworks.title: Allegorical Portrait of Jean-Baptiste Hüet
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I after Jean-Augustin Léveillé
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image is a classical-style portrait in a reddish tone. It depicts a person's profile with long hair tied back. The portrait is set inside a circular frame with the inscription "HUET NE LE 22 OCTOBRE" and is surrounded by decorative motifs of laurel leaves and roses. Three cherubic figures with curly hair and small wings are engaging in artistic activities; one holds a quill, another supports a blank sheet, and the third gazes at the work. The cherubs are depicted in a playful manner, with one clutching a flower and another holding a brush or pen. Below the frame, there are objects including a scroll, an artist’s palette, and botanical elements. The background of the image is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Artist's Father
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of varnish on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with only his upper body visible. He is positioned at a three-quarter angle, slightly turned to his left, but facing the viewer with a subtle expression. The man's facial features include a light complexion, full cheeks, and prominent eyes, while his hair is dark, curly, and falls around his face and ears. He wears a high-collared white shirt with ruffles peeking through the opening of a dark, formal coat. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background of the image is plain and uniformly dark, set within an oval vignette.

artworks.title: Les amateurs de tableaux (The Picture Enthusiasts)
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper

artworks.title: Title Page for "Plusieurs Testes Coiffées a la Persienne"
artworks.description: The image depicts a young person from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with one arm resting on a surface. They have soft facial features and curly hair, partially covered by a voluminous beret-style hat. The subject wears a robe-like garment with puffy sleeves, a bow at the neck, and multiple folds of fabric. They hold a piece of paper or scroll with visible text. The background is lightly sketched with decorative elements like round fruits and leaves. The etching is monochrome with intricate linework conveying texture and depth.

artworks.title: Woman in a Feathered Turban, Turned to the Right
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile facing to the right. They are depicted from the shoulders up, with their body turned to display their left side. The person has distinct facial features such as a prominent nose, full lips, and expressive eyes looking upwards. Their hair is styled in curls with a headdress embellished with feathers and a tassel. The individual is wearing a draped garment secured with a brooch, along with earrings. The background is plain with a light texture and enclosed in an oval border.

artworks.title: Young Moor in a Feathered Turban, Turned to the Left
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body in profile, facing left. They have distinct facial features with a notable nose, brow, and closed lips. The individual wears a turban with a feather on the right side, partially covering their dark hair. They are dressed in a high-collared garment with detailed lines and button-like embellishments down the front. The background is plain with a slight outline or oval shape, containing no additional elements or context.

artworks.title: Woman in a Feathered Turban with a Veil, Turned to the Right
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 9.5 x 7 cm (3 3/4 x 2 3/4 in.)
sheet: 10.6 x 8.2 cm (4 3/16 x 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a person with their body turned slightly to the side, and their head looking over their shoulder towards the viewer. The person's facial features are delicately rendered, with a composed expression and eyes that appear to be looking directly at the viewer. They have elaborate, voluminous hair styled upwards with decorative elements resembling feathers or embellishments, and a long drape trailing from the hairstyle. The person's clothing appears to be intricately detailed with lines suggesting texture and layers. The image is in black and white, resembling an etching or engraving, set against a textured, nondescript background. On the left side of the image is the word "Bella." Earring adornments are seen dangling from the ear.

artworks.title: Young Moor with a Slight Beard and Feathered Turban, Turned to the Left
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is positioned with his head turned slightly to the right, gazing away from the viewer. His facial features include a prominent nose, defined cheekbones, and a slightly furrowed brow, with curly hair that is partially hidden by an elaborate turban. The turban is adorned with a decorative band and a large feather emerging from the center. The man's attire consists of a richly textured jacket featuring a high collar and intricate button detailing on the chest. There are no visible signs of jewelry. The background is simple and unadorned, with minimal detail. The image has an oval vignette around the portrait.

artworks.title: Sultaness Adorned with Pearls, Turned to the Left
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up, facing slightly to the left. They have curly hair, a turban-like headpiece, and are wearing a simple garment with a necklace. The background is a textured oval frame with no specific details or scenery.

artworks.title: Bearded Moor in a Feathered Turban with a Veil, Turned to the Right
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait focused on the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned in profile, facing left. He has a thick beard and moustache, and his eyes are looking to the side. He is wearing a turban with a feather and a cloak, with the background consisting of simple lines. The signature "Bellar" is visible on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Sultaness in a Banded Turban, Turned to the Right
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and shoulders of a person. The individual is depicted in a slight three-quarter view, looking to their left. Their facial features include a prominent nose and full lips, with eyes that gaze into the distance. The person has long, curly hair that cascades down their shoulders. They are wearing an elaborate headdress that resembles a turban, styled with ornamental bands and circular jewels, including a prominent jewel in the center above the forehead. The clothing visible appears to be a draped garment. There is a signature that reads “Bella” next to the person's shoulder. The background of the portrait is plain.

artworks.title: Moor in a Turban Trimmed with Five Feathers
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 9.6 x 7.6 cm (3 3/4 x 3 in.)
sheet: 10.7 x 8.3 cm (4 3/16 x 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the shoulders up, positioned in a three-quarter view with his face turned slightly to his left. He has a prominent mustache and a confident expression. He wears a large, elaborately decorated turban with feathers and a garment with a high collar and detailed textures. He also has an earring in his ear. The background is an oval frame with a subtle textured pattern.

artworks.title: Sultaness in a Veiled Turban, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length profile of a person from the shoulder up to the head. The person is positioned in profile, facing to the right, with a slight downward tilt of the head. Their facial features include a prominent nose and plump lips with eyes gently closed or in a downward gaze. The hair is styled in an elaborate way with a large volume wrapped around the head and secured with a decorative band. Several long strands of hair fall down the back. The individual is wearing a draped garment with soft, flowing lines. A single earring dangles from the earlobe. The background is plain and minimal, with an oval border framing the subject.

artworks.title: Groom with a Camel
artworks.description: The image features a young person seen from the waist up, facing slightly away from the viewer with their head turned to the right. The individual has curly hair and is wearing a garment with a wide neckline that drapes around their shoulders. Next to them on the right is the head of a camel with a halter around its snout. The background is plain and the composition is enclosed within an oval shape.

artworks.title: Black Groom with an Arabian Horse
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a person from the waist up, situated slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. The person's facial features are intricately detailed, with a strong gaze and a neutral expression. They wear a headwrap that partially covers their hair, with some strands visible at the front and sides. The individual is clad in a sleeveless garment and draped with a fur over their shoulders. An earring is visible on their left ear. The horse next to them is shown with a detailed bridle, embellished with feathers on its head. The background is a simple oval-shaped field that frames the subjects with no additional details.

artworks.title: Motherhood (Maternité)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frank R. and Jeannette H. Eyerly
artworks.description: There is an image of a woman seated at a table. She is in a seated position, slightly turned toward the table, cradling an object that resembles a pitcher or a teapot in her arms. Her facial features are obscured due to the muted and impressionistic style of the artwork, but her hair is styled up. She is wearing a dark outfit, blending with the background, and her attire contrasts with the richly patterned and colored tablecloth that covers the round table. The tablecloth showcases a mix of greens and blues with a red and orange stripe pattern at the bottom edge. The setting includes a couple of chairs in the background and a dimly lit interior, casting shadows around her. The color palette is dark and earthy, with a soft focus that creates an intimate atmosphere.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Etching at a Window
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.7 x 12.9 cm (6 3/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frank R. and Jeannette H. Eyerly
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man sitting at a table, facing the viewer directly. He is positioned slightly to the right side of the image and leans slightly forward, resting his right arm on the table. His facial features include a broad face, pronounced cheekbones, and a straight-lined mouth. He has curly hair beneath a wide-brimmed hat that shadows part of his face. The man wears a dark, long-sleeved garment with a visible collar. On the table in front of him lie some papers or a book, which he holds with his right hand. Light enters from the left, through an open window that features detailed shading and an outdoor view of trees and a building in the distance. The room behind the man is dark, with the light from the window highlighting his features and the papers.

artworks.title: Havana
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: The John U. and Evelyn S. Nef Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a market scene with a donkey. The image portrays a lively market setting featuring a donkey and various market activities.

artworks.title: Nannies with a Child
artworks.medium: watercolor and black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The John U. and Evelyn S. Nef Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a garden scene with trees and greenery. The painting depicts a tranquil garden setting, where two large trees dominate the scene, with one having a dense green top and the other showing more branches. Between the trees, there is lush green vegetation, some tall plants or shrubs. In the foreground, there is a bench-like shape. This is in the style of Mary Cassatt. The artwork uses soft lines and a pastel color palette, giving it an impressionistic quality that focuses on capturing the leisurely and serene atmosphere of the garden space.

artworks.title: Claude Renoir, with Lowered Head
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The John U. and Evelyn S. Nef Collection
artworks.description: The image features a charcoal sketch of a young child, depicting the upper part of the body. The child is seated with their head slightly tilted to the side. Facial features including eyes, nose, and a slightly downturned mouth are detailed. The child has hair styled with a bow and wears a garment with a ruffled collar. There are no accessories or objects in the sketch. The background is subtly shaded, blending with the foreground. The signature in the bottom right corner reads "Renoir."

artworks.title: The Sedan Chair
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows three children kneeling on the ground, holding hands or possibly dancing. The central child wears a wide-brimmed hat and a long-sleeved garment. The child to the left wears a smaller hat and a jacket, seen from the back and side. The child to the right looks directly into the scene with short hair and light clothing. A small dog stands nearby. The background features sketchy trees and textured clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Woman at a Window, Reading a Letter
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a man standing inside a building, visible from the waist up and leaning out of a window with his body angled slightly toward the viewer. He is holding a piece of paper in his hands, examining it closely. A woman is outside, her back turned to the viewer, with her hair tucked under a bonnet. She wears a long dress and her body is slightly angled as she looks towards the man in the window. The etching is set against a backdrop of a building's façade, with details of brickwork and wooden window frames visible around the window where the man stands. The window is divided into smaller panes, typical of older architectural styles. The overall background is simple, with emphasis on the interaction between the two figures.
